texts.preamble: Arindam Paul vs The State Of Assam And Anr on 4 October, 2023 Page No.# 1/3 Gahc010222252023 The Gauhati High Court (High Court Of Assam, Nagaland, Mizoram And Arunachal Pradesh) Case No. : Crl.Pet./1070/2023 Arindam Paul S/O Late Mrinal Kanti Paul R/O U.N.C. Road, M/S Bharati Store, Ward No. 5, P.O. And P.S. Dhubri Dhubri, -783301, Assam Versus The State Of Assam And Anr Rep. By The Pp, Assam 2:The Designated Officer Food Safety Dist. Dhubri Office Of The Joint Director Of Health Services Dhubri District (Food Safety Branch Pin-783301 Assam 3:The Food Safety Officer District- Dhubri Office Of The Designated Officer Food Safety Dhubri C/O Joint Director Of Health Services Dhubri District Assam Pin-78330 Advocate for the Petitioner : Ms M Hazarika Advocate for the Respondent : Pp, Assam Page No.# 2/3 Before Honourable Mr. Justice Robin Phukan Arindam Paul vs The State Of Assam And Anr on 4 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191075011/ 1 Order
texts.arguments: 2. In this petition, under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C., the petitioner has prayed for quashing the proceedings of CR Case No. 135/2022, pending before the learned Addl. CJM, Dhubri under Section 26[2] read with Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act. 3. Ms. Hazarika, learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner submits that in view of the fact that the food item which was seized from the establishment of the petitioner was manufactured by ITC Limited, and further that the sample was analyzed in State Public Health Laboratory, Bamunimadam at Guwahati and the said laboratory is not authorized to analyze the chili powder and therefore, the report submitted by it is not admissible and that being the position the complaint case is not maintainable and therefore, it is contended that further proceedings of CR Case No. 135/2022, pending before the learned Addl. CJM, Dhubri under Section 26[2] read with Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act may be stayed, till disposal of this petition.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 2. In this petition, under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C., the petitioner has prayed for quashing the proceedings of CR Case No. 135/2022, pending before the learned Addl. CJM, Dhubri under Section 26[2] read with Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act. 3. Ms. Hazarika, learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner submits that in view of the fact that the food item which was seized from the establishment of the petitioner was manufactured by ITC Limited, and further that the sample was analyzed in State Public Health Laboratory, Bamunimadam at Guwahati and the said laboratory is not authorized to analyze the chili powder and therefore, the report submitted by it is not admissible and that being the position the complaint case is not maintainable and therefore, it is contended that further proceedings of CR Case No. 135/2022, pending before the learned Addl. CJM, Dhubri under Section 26[2] read with Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act may be stayed, till disposal of this petition.
